items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, they did 'Bon Bon.' But didn't 'Bon Bon' [Tunnell] fall (?) into something?

ctx.x: Oh, they did 'Bon Bon.' But didn't 'Bon Bon' [Tunnell] fall (?) into something?
Could be. He might have been. He probably never made any records. Because he made some records with Gene -- 'Nagasaki,' which is pretty wild.
